**Determine Surface Location:** Identify the location of the defining surface of the volumetric object.
**Project Texture Coordinates:** For each point $\mathbf{p}$ on the surface, compute the corresponding 2D texture coordinates $(u, v)$ by projecting $\mathbf{p}$ through the texture space.
**Sample Texture:** Retrieve the color value from the 2D texture map using the computed $(u, v)$ coordinates.
**Composite:** Blend the sampled texture color with the underlying volumetric or geometric shading.
Let $\mathbf{p}$ be the 3D point on the surface.
